entities.summary: Joshua Thomas Kinney is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the St. Louis Cardinals, Chicago White Sox, and Seattle Mariners. He threw a slider, four-seam fastball, curveball, and a two-seam fastball.
